content.comment_body: Hello, I need assistance connecting several 10k NTC thermistors to the analog inputs of the [product_name] AM2 module, if that's feasible. Thank you and regards.

It is recommended to use external transmitters for NTCs that provide 0-10V or 0/4-20mA outputs. NTC thermistors have a non-linear response, so direct connection isn't straightforward. In [product_name], you would need to break the curve into segments and calculate them accordingly.

analysis.insight_summary: A user wants to connect 10k NTC thermistors directly to an analog input on an AM2 module, but the non-linear nature of NTC sensors makes direct measurement challenging. An alternative suggestion involves using transmitters that convert the NTC signal to a standardized voltage or current output, enabling easier processing within the system.
analysis.user_expectations: The user aims to directly wire 10k NTC thermistors to analog inputs for straightforward temperature readings.
